scripts.justification: MercadoPago Bricks SDK — card tokenisation client-side (PCI DSS Rule 12). Raw card data never reaches the merchant server; MP issues a one-time token.
scripts.note: MP does not publish SRI hashes for this SDK. Monitor https://www.mercadopago.cl/developers/en/docs/changelog/announcements for version changes and re-review on each major SDK update.
